name: MVTec LOCO AD: Logically Consistent Anomaly Detection Dataset
description: Industrial visual anomaly detection benchmark of 3,644 high-resolution images across five industrial product categories (Breakfast Box, Juice Bottle, Pushpins, Screw Bag, and Splicing Connectors). Specifically designed to evaluate both structural anomalies (local physical surface damage like scratches or cracks) and logical anomalies (rule violations, missing components, incorrect counts, or forbidden spatial arrangements).
